svg.text: SKY130 HD | counter_sky130.v | 31 standard cells | no retiming
Clock sequence: clk_1 then clk_2; active HIGH and non-overlapping. rst_n=0 asynchronously clears all 16 data latches.
Matching net labels are electrically connected. count_o[i] = count[i]. Cell instance names use an x prefix for SPICE.
en=1: advance modulo 16 after the two phases. en=0: hold via recirculation. Phase-2 selection uses en_1 sampled in phase 1.
Cells: 16 x dlrtp_1 | 1 x dlxtp_1 | 8 x mux2_1 | 2 x and2_1 | 3 x xor2_1 | 1 x inv_1
Standard-cell schematic. Local symbols retain SKY130 pin maps and power attributes; no transistor-level simulation setup is included.
